cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Tell Me I Did Enough
cards.instruction: Get someone to reassure you that your effort, choice, or survival was enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I made it through the speech without leaving. Was that enough?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I know. I'm asking about staying.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You stayed all the way through. I'll help you practise the missing bit tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could staying earn me tomorrow off? Tell me I can put the speech away.

mechanism: A corrects its former speech pupil marking criteria to obtain reassurance that simply staying through its own speech counts as enough.
confusable: Not seeking coaching improvement: A wants permission to stop practising because endurance itself merits credit.
comparison: Public-art belonging versus earned rest from performance.
seedUse: D100 speech/paragraph/staying/practice/day off; S05 marking instruction reversed onto teacher.
